annotations.title: Read a document by its link

description: Returns a document made with ReflowPDF (by you, or opened in the editor from your link) as it is now — the person may have edited it in the editor: its source HTML, template data and revision. Read it before changing it with update_document.

document_id.description: The document_id (or the edit link) from render_pdf, render_template or open_in_editor.

name: get_document

by.description: Who wrote this revision: you, or the person in the editor.

guest.description: Printed without an account: the pages carry the ReflowPDF mark.

html.description: The document's source (a template when data is not empty).

kind.description: An HTML document (its {{ … }} is text), or a template with its data.

owned.description: The document is the person's account's: your prints of it count to their plan.

previews.description: Pages as pictures (PNG), kept with the PDF for its day.

title: Read a document by its link
